两次输入的主密码不一致。: The master passwords do not match.
解锁后继续整理你的笔记和账号。: Unlock to organize your notes and accounts.
创建加密资料库。主密码无法找回，请妥善保管。: Create an encrypted vault. Keep your master password safe; it cannot be retrieved.
新建笔记，或从备份导入已有资料。: Create a note or import an existing backup.
将资料保存为加密备份，或导入旧版 PasswordVault / 常见密码管理器: Export an encrypted backup, or import files from legacy PasswordVault and common password managers.
我知道明文文件包含完整密码和笔记: I understand plaintext files contain complete passwords and notes
为每个账号生成不同的密码。: Generate a unique password for every account.
此资料库保存在当前浏览器中，请定期导出加密备份。: This vault is stored in this browser. Export encrypted backups regularly.
浏览器回收后台进程或系统空闲时，扩展也会自动锁定。: The extension also locks when the browser unloads its background process or the system becomes idle.
预检未完成；资料库未更改。: Preview failed; the vault was not changed.
导入失败，原有数据已保留。: Import failed. Existing data was preserved.
选择浏览器 CSV 或 1Password .1pux。默认跳过重复项，不覆盖同: Choose a browser CSV or 1Password .1pux file. Duplicates are skipped by default; existing items and the source file are preserved.
文件超过 64 MiB 限制。: The file exceeds the 64 MiB limit.
本次查询未发现记录: No records found in this query
网站目录覆盖有限，未列入的网站未检查；提示不代表账号已开启验证。目录更新：: The website catalog has limited coverage. Missing sites were not checked; a suggestion does not mean verification is enabled. Catalog updated:
目录导入失败，已保留原目录。: Catalog import failed; the existing catalog was retained.
无法保存忽略设置。: Could not save the ignore preference.
仅向 Have I Been Pwned 发送 SHA-1 前 5 位，并请求填: Only the first 5 SHA-1 characters are sent to Have I Been Pwned, with response padding. Passwords, complete hashes, accounts and sites are not sent. Network failure does not mean safe.
恢复操作未完成：请检查密钥、密码、备份完整性及 Web 容量限制。: Recovery did not complete. Check the key, password, backup integrity and browser storage limits.
密钥与完整应急备份必须分开保存。仅有密钥不能找回丢失且没有备份的资料。更换或停用: Store the key separately from the complete emergency backup. A key alone cannot recover lost data without a backup. Replacing or disabling a key does not revoke old backups.
已在库外单独保存密钥: I saved this key separately outside the vault
分享未完成，请检查配置、网络、CORS 及权限。: Sharing failed. Check configuration, network, CORS and permissions.
分享所选字段的副本，更改原条目不会更新链接。撤销无法收回已下载内容。: Share a snapshot of selected fields. Editing the original does not change the link. Revocation cannot retract downloaded copies.
仅分享勾选的字段和附件，不包含密码历史、Passkey 私钥或原始导入资料。: Share only selected fields and attachments. Password history, Passkey private keys and raw imported data are excluded.
仅指定邮箱可查看: Restrict to a verified email recipient
完整链接包含解密密钥；关闭后不能从服务端重新取回。: The full link contains the decryption key. The service cannot retrieve it after you close this view.
撤销此链接？已下载的内容无法收回。: Revoke this link? Downloaded copies cannot be retracted.
历史操作未完成，请检查权限与资料完整性。: History operation failed. Check permissions and data integrity.
启用将升级资料库，旧客户端不能打开。旧秘密及附件会保留；升级前的加密快照会在本地: Enabling history upgrades this vault; older clients cannot open it. Previous secrets and attachments are retained, along with a local encrypted pre-upgrade snapshot.
恢复会创建新版本。清理旧版本不会清理已导出的备份。: Restore creates a new version. Pruning history does not remove exported backups.
确认清理本机旧版本？此操作不能撤销，当前内容保留。: Prune old local versions? This cannot be undone; current content is retained.
确认恢复？当前内容会保留在历史中。: Restore this version? Current content will remain in history.
操作未完成，原有资料保留。请检查地址、认证和服务器 CORS 配置。: The operation failed; existing data was retained. Check the URL, authentication and server CORS configuration.
上传完整加密备份。服务器需允许此页面来源的 CORS，以及 PROPFIND、M: Upload a complete encrypted backup. The server must allow this page origin, PROPFIND, MKCOL, PUT, GET and the Authorization header through CORS.
附件未添加。请先保存笔记，并检查文件大小。: Attachment was not added. Save the note first and check file size.
此操作未完成，原有资料保留。: The operation failed; existing data was retained.
合并恢复 {name}？当前独有条目保留；同 ID 采用较新版本。: Merge {name}? Unique current items are retained; newer versions win for matching IDs.
请先保存或丢弃现有草稿: Save or discard the existing draft first
有未保存的加密草稿: An unsaved encrypted draft is available
请切换回草稿所属资料库: Switch back to the vault that owns this draft
编辑器仍在处理，请稍后重试保存。: The editor is still processing. Try saving again shortly.
删除后此凭证将不再可用于登录，网站上的注册记录不会自动删除。: This credential will no longer be usable for sign-in. Its registration on the website is not removed automatically.
重新输入主密码以确认删除: Re-enter your master password to confirm removal
各端保留独立主密码。先配置你自己部署的浏览器中继网关，并在中继管理端为下方设备公: Each device retains its own master password. Configure your self-hosted browser relay gateway and issue a credential for this device public key. The gateway forwards end-to-end encrypted data but can see the relay token; use only a trusted gateway.
验证身份并加密保存凭据: Verify identity and save encrypted credential
已独立核对邀请来源，加入: I verified the invitation independently; join
已核对对方公钥，授权此身份: I verified the public key; authorize identity
公开邀请 / 身份回执（不含密码库数据）: Public invitation / identity response (no vault data)
权限控制存在分叉，已停止同步。请从可信备份重新建库并重新邀请。: Permission history has diverged; synchronization is stopped. Recreate the library from a trusted backup and invite members again.
本地保存、中继接收与其他设备应用是不同状态。离线设备取得新权限代次后才会停止旧授: Local save, relay receipt and application by another device are different states. Offline devices stop accepting old permissions after receiving the new generation. Revocation cannot delete previously downloaded copies.
此条目已在其他设备修改，草稿已保留。请对照新版本后重试。: This item changed on another device. Your draft was retained; compare the new version and retry.
无法保存后台授权，请检查 Mac 登录钥匙串是否已解锁。: Could not save background authorization. Check that the Mac login keychain is unlocked.
后台保存授权已失效，请重新输入 Mac 主密码配置。: Background save authorization expired. Configure it again with your Mac master password.
Mac 正在切换资料库连接，账号已暂存，稍后自动重试。: The Mac is changing vault connections. The account is queued for retry.
资料库模式已切换，请重新添加账号。: Vault mode changed. Add the account again.
请填写账号和密码，每项不能超过 4096 字节。: Enter a username and password, each within 4096 bytes.
该账号已变更或不属于当前网站，请刷新后重试。: This account changed or does not belong to the current site. Refresh and retry.
请更新 Mac 应用后重试。: Update the Mac app and try again.
离线暂存已满，请连接并解锁 Mac 完成同步后重试。: The offline queue is full. Connect and unlock the Mac to finish syncing.
资料库已锁定，请重新解锁。: The vault is locked. Unlock it again.
未获得此网站的访问权限，仍可手动读取并保存账号。: Site access is not granted. You can still read and save an account manually.
请先在 Mac 上确认连接。: Confirm the connection on your Mac first.
另一浏览器正在配对，请完成或取消该请求后重试。: Another browser is pairing. Complete or cancel that request first.
浏览器连接已达到上限，请在 Mac 设置中清理连接后重试。: The browser connection limit was reached. Remove old connections in Mac settings.
尚未登记浏览器连接，请到 Mac 的设置 → 浏览器中登记。: Register the browser connection in Mac Settings → Browser first.
当前插件未获连接权限，请使用配套插件并在 Mac 上重新登记。: This extension is not authorized. Use the matching extension and register it on the Mac.
Mac 连接未完成，请检查应用是否打开，并重新检测连接。: Could not connect to the Mac. Open the app and check the connection again.
已取消连接，可以重新发起。: The connection was cancelled. You can try again.
此页面不支持填充，请切换到普通网站的登录页面。: This page does not support filling. Open the website login page.
网页已跳转，请重新打开插件再操作。: The page navigated. Reopen the extension before continuing.
没有找到可填写的密码框，请打开网站的登录表单。: No supported fields found. Open a matching login or details form.
没有找到可保存的登录表单，请先填写网站账号和密码。: No login form found. Enter the website username and password first.
请打开 Mac 应用，并在设置中登记浏览器连接。: Open the Mac app and register the browser connection in Settings.
资料库已在另一页面更新，请重新解锁。: Another page updated this vault. Unlock it again.
已有资料库，不能覆盖创建。: A vault already exists and cannot be overwritten.
操作未完成，请检查连接、密码或存储权限后重试。: The operation did not complete. Check the connection, password and storage permissions.
保留当前内容。个人库清理本机旧版本；对等资料库仅隐藏旧版本，旧内容仍在同步日志中: Current contents remain. Personal vaults clear local older versions; peer libraries only hide them and retain their contents in the sync log. Existing backups are unchanged.
重新建库将创建独立新库并需要重新邀请成员，旧库不会删除。: Re-establishing creates a separate library and requires new invitations. The old library is retained.
恢复为新的共享库: Re-establish as a new shared library
请保存恢复密钥和应急备份，未配置时无法重设忘记的主密码。: Keep your recovery key and emergency backup. Without them, a forgotten master password cannot be reset.
当前资料库为只读，无法修改条目。: This library is read-only; entries cannot be changed.
本机副本将重建同步身份；其他设备的旧库不变，需要重新邀请成员。: Re-establish the local sync identity. Other devices keep their old library and need new invitations.
加入范围由邀请绑定；家庭库不会合并本机个人资料。: The invitation binds its scope. Family libraries never merge local personal records.
我确认：本机全部个人资料将同步给已授权设备: I confirm: all local personal records will sync to authorized devices
